outcome: Need for more than one induction agent
Hypoxic ischaemic encephalopathy/need for therapeutic hypothermia
cohort: The participants were 86 stakeholders across four groups: midwives, obstetricians, neonatologists, and women's representatives, participating in an international Delphi survey.
finding: An international multistakeholder Delphi study identified a core outcome set of 28 outcomes across four domains (short-term maternal, short-term offspring, long-term maternal, long-term offspring) for trials on induction of labour.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as a core short-term maternal outcome to be reported in trials on induction of labour.
